snippet.title: Very Short Devlog video showcasing the crafting mechanic in Little Hoarder
snippet.description:
Currently few bugs to work out, the inventory system splits items forever, so infinite resources! So does crafting apparently. Having a blast though making my first project. Soon on steam
stay tuned 
Want to support the journey? and even get something out of it? 
Check out https://www.patreon.com/c/FlowConstruct
Want to find out more about the game? Dig in our website : https://www.flowforgestudios.co.uk

Steam link coming soon I promise:

Video, assets, sound, made by me :)
